model: gpt-6.1-terra via signed-in local Codex CLI
method: Use held pictures from the original first scene and two consecutive equal-length recordings. Randomly permute the source order per film. The 24 distinct pairs preserve independently labelled events. Eight additional pairs repeat the exact recorded samples and eight replace one recording with exact digital silence. Each condition uses a fresh session with identical instructions, picture, audio, options, CLAP audio-to-audio similarities and separate spectra. The reader can replay either excerpt with ask_scene to compare both alternatives independently. Only the measured comparison directly includes each channel’s match to the supplied descriptions and the mean target-minus-reference change. The previous adapter accepts the same call and returns the existing audio-to-audio report. No native WAV or optional 30B model. Readers may pick the same answer twice or abstain. Individual and pair scores count abstentions as incorrect for named events. Silence is reported separately.

similarity.basis: Rows follow the reference channels and columns the target channels in recording order. Each encoder input contains one channel of one excerpt at its recorded level, played once with zero padding. Null means no signal at the encoder rate. A higher cosine indicates more similar whole-clip audio features. Background sound can contribute. The score does not identify an object, speaker or word.

description_comparison.basis: Each row is one recorded channel. Columns follow the supplied descriptions. The change subtracts the reference from the target after averaging the active channels of each recording. A positive change means greater similarity to that description in the target. Either sound may occur twice or in neither recording. The catalogue lists the closest AudioSet terms on the same recording and encoder, independently of your descriptions. These scores are uncalibrated. Use them to check whether either description fits what you heard.

catalogue_method: A third fresh session per case received the same description scores and signed changes, plus the three closest of 527 AudioSet catalogue labels per active channel from the same CLAP recording embeddings. These labels are not restricted to the suggestions. Other tools, media, instructions and choices match the two initial runs. This is extra context from the same encoder, not corroboration by a second model.

catalogue_distinct_both_correct_differen.method: vs existing comparison; 20,000 paired film bootstrap draws, seed 7035
catalogue_distinct_both_correct_differen.scope: The same six films had both answers correct in these two runs. Resampling these observed pairs gives a constant zero difference; it does not measure repeat-session variability or establish equivalence on other films.

held_out_esc50.method: Fixed RNG seed 9064773. Select 32 distinct fold-4 recordings from the existing 50-category local panel. Each pair uses full 5 s waveforms from different official supercategories. Supply the gold name for one recording and a distractor from a third supercategory. Randomize label and clip order independently, no full-score or negative count told to reader. Verified original WAV Git blob hashes and annotation CSV against the official tree.
held_out_esc50.protocol: Audio only. Two consecutive full five-second recordings on the same playback clock, no native WAV. Present exactly the same choices and question to both readers. The source labels come from ESC-50. A secondary sound may be audible. No human re-rated these edited pairs. These are different source recordings and categories from the filmed comparison.

by_pair.annotation_note: Both readers answered cat for drinking_sipping. Cat was a supplied distractor.

release_method: When the two active recordings have different encoder features, the returned text and numbers match the with_catalogue condition. If a waveform has no encoder-rate signal, no sound-identity change can be measured. If features are identical in channel order there is zero measured change. In these two situations the released comparison returns its status and change without proposing a source; readers can ask_scene with either released interval. All 16 affected controls were rerun after this change. The 24 distinct film and 16 ESC-50 comparisons were replayed through the released comparator to verify identical report values (including option order) to those actually received by their readers. Their existing with_catalogue answers are used without counting additional sessions.
release_decision: Expose this evidence when a reader explicitly supplies descriptions. Existing unnamed comparisons continue to return the original recording similarities. Overall two-sound identification did not increase on the 24 distinct films. The open-set and control measurements describe the limits of source naming.
